newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese killer executed by firing squad.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese killer executed by firing squad.

text.p: A Lebanese man convicted of killing his fiancee and a policeman was executed by firing squad early on Thursday, judicial sources said.
They said 27-year-old Anas Dibyan, sentenced to death in July by a military court, was executed at Roumyeh jail in mountains northeast of Beirut.

He was convicted of shooting dead his fiancee Nora Hamade then stabbing to death first adjutant Rafik Mahmoud, head of the police station of the town of Moukhtara who was pursuing him two days after the January 4 murder.
It was the seventh execution in Lebanon since the 1975-90 civil war.
